DESCRIPTION:
We run a food delivery app in one city. We want to show customers an honest delivery estimate. The estimate is shown to the customer in the app. The target is actual_minutes, the minutes from order to delivery. We estimate when the order is placed, before a courier is assigned. An estimate within five minutes counts as good.

FILES (headers only):
orders.csv: order_id, order_time, restaurant_id, distance_km, couriers_online, weather, basket_items, order_value, delivered_at, courier_rating, actual_minutes
